description: This file implements an HTTP handler for serving diff artifacts and viewer assets, including rate limiting, request parsing, and security policies.

classes.name: ViewerFailureLimiter
classes.description: Manages rate limiting for viewer requests based on IP addresses, including failure tracking and lockout periods.

methods.name: parseRequestUrl
methods.description: Parses a raw URL string into a URL object, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: serveAsset
methods.description: Serves viewer assets like images or scripts, handling errors and HTTP method restrictions.

methods.name: respondText
methods.description: Sends a plain text HTTP response with specified status code and body.

methods.name: setSharedHeaders
methods.description: Sets common security and cache headers on the HTTP response.

methods.name: normalizeRemoteClientKey
methods.description: Normalizes remote IP addresses for consistent rate limiting keys.

methods.name: isLoopbackClientIp
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: hasProxyForwardingHints
methods.description: Determines if request headers suggest proxy forwarding.

methods.name: resolveViewerAccess
methods.description: Resolves whether a request is from a local or remote client based on IP and proxy headers.

methods.name: recordRemoteFailure
methods.description: Records a failure for a remote client in the rate limiter.

methods.name: resetRemoteFailures
methods.description: Resets failure count for a remote client in the rate limiter.
